name: Camera locks to the interpolated body center at all 21 classes and all render phases
Production drawing stays centered through high speed, depth, pause and selected-system view
Background uses the same camera transform as bodies and the forecast
Photo mode keeps its free camera and restores the saved camera without forcing a lock
R recenters and resets zoom while photo controls remain independent
Depth-aware camera and pointer remain aligned after floating-origin rebasing
Resize, cinematic zoom and restart cannot displace the locked body
Forecast begins at the drawn body position on all axes rather than at the raw simulation point
Fast forecasts clip to the inset with a visible endpoint in every direction and astronomical scale
Forecast horizon no longer jumps by astronomical class
Fixed-step gravity forecast matches actual coasting against a static source
Continuous relative contact detects moving fast threats before a path passes through them
Forecast and local pointer handle near-rest, depth motion and zero speed without nonfinite values
Mouse steering uses the rendered center and corrects projection tilt
Forecast calculations never mutate simulation positions, velocities, or mass
Performance mode bounds prediction sources and samples under dense nearby gravity
Microscopic and crowded field labels cannot cover the body or its local pointer
Photo panning an offscreen player does not leave a stray local pointer on screen
Fixed-step input keeps mouse aim centered before the next render updates the camera
